title: Glorious tiered city project, a mansion, and a wildfire
content: There was a brief moment in the start of the dream, where I was working in someone's house, helping them take care of the house. It was a huge mansion, with ceiling high windows and red curtains and shiny wood floors. As I was working on something, I looked outside to see everything was on fire. The TV was on, explaining there was a wildfire and everyone needed to leave. I tried to convince the house owners to leave with me, but they just stared blankly at me and told me I started the fire. I did not start the fire, or at least I don't remember doing so. But everyone was telling me I started it. Even the TV people were now staring at me in that same blank way, telling me I started the fire. Then the house owners tried to grab me, but I slipped away from them and ran out some side door, where there wasn't any fire yet. Somehow, I got away from it all. I don't know what happened to the house or the people inside, I just ran endlessly. Until I reached the city. The main part of the dream was a huge tiered city project. It's hard to describe, but it reminded me a lot of Skyreach from WoW. The idea of the open platforms on tall ledges anyway. The actual look was more like a garden area with a lot of greenery. There was also a lot of clean glass elements, some of the floors were clear glass and you could look down below to the rest of the "city." There were apartments built into cliffsides, with these glass elevators delivering residents to each floor. The city overlooked a green, rainforest like valley, and some of the common area ledges were built around natural waterfalls. I briefly met with the planning team for this city, and they explained that it was completely free to live there, no rent or anything. Instead of paying money, there was some kind of committee people would send in applications to, and based on like hundreds of factors and cross-analysis in a database, they would be given a selection of housing options meeting at least some of their criteria, and then be allowed to choose where they moved to from that list. I left the city for some reason I forgot. On my way out, down some stairs, two self-identified arson investigators stopped me and had a good hard look at me, but then just shrugged and continued on their way up to the city, letting me go. Just sharing this here because I thought the city might be worth discussing. Anyone else see something like it?
